title: Indicators Used to Measure Impact of Productivity Grants on SMEs
what_it_is: Indicators Used to Measure Impact of Productivity Grants on SMEs

sections.label: Grant impact studies findings
sections.summary: An impact analysis for the Market Readiness Assistance grant was published, and a 2020 study of 129 companies found over 80% of PSG projects achieved productivity gains.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, an impact analysis for the Market Readiness Assistance grant was published in the Economic Survey of Singapore Third Quarter 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In another study in 2020, Enterprise Singapore sampled 129 companies on the impact of the Productivity Solutions Grant (PSG) and found that more than 80% of these projects had achieved various forms of productivity gains in terms of cost savings, time savings and revenue gains.

sections.label: Productivity Solutions Grant introduction
sections.summary: PSG was introduced in 2018 to support enterprises' transformation, aligned to Industry Transformation Maps, for adopting pre-scoped IT solutions, equipment or consultancy services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Productivity Solutions Grant (PSG) was introduced in 2018 to support our enterprises in their transformation journey and they are aligned to the Industry Transformation Map (ITMs) to support our enterprises to adopt IT solutions, equipment or consultancy services that are pre-scoped by the industry's leading agency.

sections.label: PSG applications and top sectors
sections.summary: Between FY2019 and FY2021, over 116,100 applications were received, nearly 95% of complete submissions approved, with retail, food and beverage, and construction as top sectors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Between FY2019 and FY2021, over the three years, more than 116,100 applications were received.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Nearly 95% of the complete submissions were approved.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: When I cited the impact study earlier, we are looking at the data and certainly, in due course, we will share more details.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Suffice to say, the top three sectors are retail, food and beverage, and construction.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: We are heartened that the companies in these three sectors are really taking up PSG to raise the productivity gains.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to assure him that we will certainly share more details from the impact studies.
